candidates.title: Story Scroll Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen layout into a story_scroll experience with integrated path choices.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off, suggesting users get stuck reading early story content.

story.headline: Begin Your Companion Journey
story.body: Scroll through the origin story to choose how your new desktop pet will join your workspace.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving onboarding steps and core narrative job is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets 23.8% drop-off on choose_path with a full screen redesign, but lacks support ticket evidence.

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery Safety Guarantee
candidates.change: Add reassurance text on the sign-in screen confirming existing pets and progress will be safely linked to your account.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing user anxiety during account setup.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically backs up and syncs all your pets and custom items securely.

guard.reason: Adding reassurance copy regarding account backup on sign-in screen complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy addition directly addressing 8 support emails regarding sign-in pet loss anxiety.

candidates.title: Split Screen Pet Adoption & Certificate Hub
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption pick_friend screen using a split layout to highlight pet personality alongside certificate creation.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest single-step drop-off with only 63.2% conversion and a 1017s mean completion time.

pick_friend.headline: Adopt Your Unique Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend to see their dynamic adoption certificate side by side.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend with a split view previewing the certificate does not remove required steps or core functionality.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact on adoption step (36.8% drop-off), but expensive full-screen layout redesign.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Setup Checklist on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Add an explicit interactive display setup checklist to the waiting screen to guide desktop rendering setup.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting pets not showing up on desktop, and home step wait time averages 2336s.

components.text:
1. Verify screen overlay permissions
2. Keep app running in system tray
3. Select primary display monitor

guard.reason: text in 'waiting.components[0].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['\n']

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Control Basics Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a new screen before home_intro that teaches core desktop pet interaction shortcuts like hiding, dragging, and talking.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.

new_pet_controls.headline: Mastering Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_controls.body: Drag to move your pet, right-click to hide to tray, or click to chat anytime.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Requirements Guide
candidates.change: Add clear image quality guidelines and hints on the photo upload screen to ensure high-fidelity pet generation.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit, clear photos focused on a single subject for best rendering results.

guard.reason: Adding image quality guidance to the photo upload screen is valid inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Cheap hint addition backed by 3 support emails on adoption generation failures.

candidates.title: Spotlight View for Story Screen
candidates.change: Change the story screen layout to a spotlight format to emphasize core pet narrative before path selection.
candidates.why: The median time for choose_path is fast (8s) but mean is 514s, showing a long tail of hesitant users.

guard.reason: Changing the story screen layout to a spotlight view preserves the pet story introduction job.

candidates.score_note: Layout tweak addressing choose_path duration tail, but lacks support mail confirmation.

candidates.title: Exclusive Pet Item Sign-In Bonus Callout
candidates.change: Display a visual sign-in bonus badge offering an exclusive starter item upon creating or linking an account.
candidates.why: Boosting sign-in motivation helps retain users before entering the high drop-off adoption phase.

guard.reason: Promoting an exclusive bonus item ('Unlock Golden Collar Bonus') violates Rule 3, which prohibits mentioning gifts, bonuses, or free extras in onboarding copy.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Verification Flow
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live visual status updates of the companion build process.
candidates.why: Home target step has high drop-off (81.3% pass rate) and long mean wait times (2336s).

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen visual layout to show live assembly progress complies with waiting screen requirements.

candidates.score_note: Complex new flow to fix 2336s wait duration on home step; requires heavy development effort.

candidates.title: Desktop Tray Quick-Access Notification
candidates.change: Add system tray quick-access instructions and notification toggle on the final home_intro screen.
candidates.why: Users report confusion about pet desktop behavior and post-onboarding feature misbehavior.

home_intro.hint: Your pet is active! Access settings anytime via the desktop system tray icon.

guard.reason: Adding system tray instructions and notification options to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop-off on finish step (35.2%) and reported user confusion about desktop behavior.

picked: Split Screen Pet Adoption & Certificate Hub

decisions.title: Split Screen Pet Adoption & Certificate Hub
